course.title: Technology for Teaching and Learning 1
course.description: Foundational course on integrating technology in teaching and learning

modules.title: Teaching and Learning with Technology: An Introduction
modules.description: Introduction to the role of technology in modern education
objectives: Understand the fundamentals of technology in education
Recognize the importance of ICT in 21st-century learning
Identify key concepts in technology-enhanced learning

modules.title: ICT Policies and Issues: Implications to Teaching and Learning
modules.description: Exploring ICT policies and their impact on educational practices
objectives: Understand policy implications for teaching and learning

modules.title: Non-digital and Digital Skills and Tools in Delivering Technology Enhanced Lessons
modules.description: Development of skills for using both digital and non-digital tools in teaching

modules.title: Social Ethical and Legal Responsibilities in the Use of Technology Tools and Resources
modules.description: Understanding ethical considerations in educational technology use
objectives: Recognize social implications of technology use
Apply ethical principles in technology integration
Comply with legal requirements for educational technology

modules.title: Theories and Principles in the Use and Design of Technology Driven Lessons
objectives: Understand learning theories related to technology
Apply design principles to technology-enhanced lessons
Evaluate lesson designs based on theoretical frameworks

modules.title: Innovative Technologies for Assessment Tasks in Teaching and Learning
modules.description: Using emerging technologies for educational assessment

modules.title: Universal Design for Learning (UDL)
modules.description: Creating inclusive learning environments through technology

modules.title: Producing Learning Resources Using Technology Tools
modules.description: Creating educational resources with digital tools

modules.title: Integrating Active Learning Approaches in Language-Learning
modules.description: Using technology to support active and interactive language learning
